Female anatomy reference
Original anatomical assets: Human Reference Atlas (HuBMAP), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein. CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library
https://3d.nih.gov/entries/3DPX-020992
Primary source: https://cdn.humanatlas.io/digital-objects/ref-organ/united-female/v1.10/assets/3d-vh-f-united.glb
Pelvic bone supplement: https://cdn.humanatlas.io/digital-objects/ref-organ/united-female/v1.5/assets/3d-vh-f-united.glb
Optimised derivative geometry and metadata: https://github.com/slorksmo/Human-Atlas
Jiki adaptations: selected 956 adult female meshes; excluded borrowed male skeleton, separate-donor leg muscles and pregnancy meshes; repacked compressed geometry; added interactive filters, colours, separation and learning text. Original source IDs and anatomical geometry retained. Coverage is partial, particularly skeleton and muscles.
